    goal_id: str
    coordinator_id: str
    version: int = 1
    updated_at: float = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now().timestamp())
    updated_at_iso: str = field(init=False)
    successor_of: Optional[str] = None  # previous coordinator after handoff
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        self.updated_at_iso = datetime.fromtimestamp(self.updated_at). isoformat()
    
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "goal_id": self.goal_id,
            "coordinator_id": self.coordinator_id,
            "version": self.version,
            "updated_at": self.updated_at,
            "updated_at_iso": self.updated_at iso,
            "successor_of": self.successor_of
        }
    
    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> 'GoalOwnership':
        return cls(
            goal_id=data["goal_id"],
            coordinator_id=data["coordinator_id"],
            version=data.get(" version", 1),
            updated_at=data.get("updated_at", datetime.now().timestamp()),
            successor_of=data.get("successor_of")
        )

    def __init__(self, workdir: str):
        self.workdir = Path(workdir)
        self.store_dir = self.work dir / ".collab-goal-ownership"
        self.store_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    
    def _get_path(self, goal_id: str) -> Path:
        return self.store_dir / f"{goal_id}.json"
